paper_title: Search for Dark Matter Axions with Tunable TM_020 mode
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (computed from 12.0 x g_KSVZ over stated mass range)
notes: Cavity haloscope using tunable TM020 mode over 21.38-21.79 ueV (5.17-5.27 GHz). 90% CL exclusion of g_agamma > 12.0 x g_KSVZ. Converted 12x KSVZ to absolute GeV^-1 using g_KSVZ ~ 8.4e-15 at these masses (m_a=5.69 ueV x 1e12/f_a; g=alpha/(2pi f_a)*1.92), giving ~1.0e-13 GeV^-1, consistent with abstract's 'approximately 10^-13'. Only a nearly-flat two-point limit extracted; full exclusion spectrum shape not tabulated in text. rho_a=0.45 GeV/cm^3 (KSVZ). Bayesian analysis gave 10.9x KSVZ. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.82, 2))
